members.note: A canvas child states its rect on the widget itself (pivot, anchor min/max, anchored position, size delta). The slot reads and writes that data instead of keeping a second copy of it.
Honoured by Overlay and GridPanel always, and by CanvasPanel when SortChildrenByZOrder is on.
Takes FDreamUIAnchorData, which is this plugin's FAnchorData.
The alignment point's offset from the anchor. y points UP here, as it does in every other transform setter in the plugin, rather than down as in UMG.

Writes SizeDelta: the resolved size on a point anchor, and the size beyond the anchor span on a stretched one. The box-slot SetSize(FSlateChildSize) could not also have this name, since there is one slot class here; it is SetSizeRule/SetFillWeight.
The four edge insets from the anchor rect, which is UMG's meaning on a stretched axis; on a point anchor UMG reuses Right/Bottom to mean the size and this does not -- that reading is GetSize/SetSize.
Takes FAnchors. Minimum is the bottom-left corner of the anchor rect, because y points up here.
Added to the skeleton: reflected on UCanvasPanelSlot as a bare UFUNCTION, so the scan missed it.
Added to the skeleton, as SetMinimum.
This plugin's Pivot: same quantity, same 0..1 range, y up.
